rubrics.justification: Mostly reflects the provided 3AB grade, but it incorrectly describes stage 3 as an expanded blastocyst with thinning zona (more consistent with stage 4) and cannot truly assess image-visible features because no image was provided.

Integrates age, tubal factor, prior ectopic/miscarriage, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle reasonably well with embryo quality, though AMH is unavailable and Day 4 transfer context is not fully explored.

The reasoning is structured and generally consistent, with conclusions mostly supported by the case data; the main issue is some overstatement of morphology and confidence despite the stage/transfer-day mismatch.

Mostly evidence-aligned on SET and general prognosis, but recommending ERA and immunologic/NK-cell workup is not routinely guideline-supported, and strong PGT-A endorsement after a single failed transfer in a 32-year-old is somewhat overstated.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer management and contingency planning, though some recommendations are broader than necessary and not all are tightly tailored to this specific case.
